description: This Java class, StandingInstructionAssembler, is part of the Fineract project. It primarily manages the assembly and configuration of standing instructions related to account transfers, including reading parameters from JSON commands and constructing associated domain objects.

classes.name: StandingInstructionAssembler
classes.description: A service class responsible for assembling and configuring standing instructions for account transfers based on JSON commands.

methods.name: assembleSavingsToSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Creates AccountTransferDetails for savings to savings transfer and attaches standing instructions.

methods.name: assembleStandingInstruction
methods.description: Extracts parameters from the JSON command to create and set a standing instruction on the account transfer details.

methods.name: assembleSavingsToLoanTransfer
methods.description: Creates AccountTransferDetails for savings to loan transfer and attaches standing instructions.

methods.name: assembleLoanToSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Creates AccountTransferDetails for loan to savings transfer and attaches standing instructions.
